title: Misty River Equestrian Center
specs: Large outdoor arena and two indoor arenas
Classroom and pond with picnic tables
Riders must wear ASTM/SEI certified horseback riding helmet, boots with 1/2 to 1 1/2 inch heel, long pants
Unable to safely accommodate riders exceeding 200 lbs
Heights and weights requested prior to or at first lesson
includes: Use of indoor and outdoor arenas
blurb: Misty River Equestrian Center provides horsemanship lessons through 4 levels for ages 8 and up, focusing on riding skills and horse care. They also offer Pony Pal lessons for children ages 4 to 7 to introduce basic horsemanship. The facility includes indoor and outdoor arenas and a classroom.
extraNote: Board due on first of every month · Veterinary and Farrier care is owner's responsibility · Proof of current vaccinations required for boarding
